Province widens wildfire evacuation order

The province widened an evacuation order on Friday evening as a wildfire west of the valley grew to more than nine thousand hectares, pushed by dry winds that forecasters expect to last through the weekend.

About four hundred homes along the highway corridor are now under the order. Residents were told to leave by the north route, since the south road was closed to all but fire crews and local traffic.

An evacuation centre opened at the high school gym, with cots, meals and a pet area. Officials asked anyone staying with friends or family to register anyway, so that crews know who has left.

Fire officials said the next two days are critical. Cooler weather and some rain are forecast for Monday, which would give crews a chance to strengthen the guard lines on the fire's eastern flank.
